material.text: @gblab/opencode-dcp: OpenCode plugin that optimizes token usage by pruning obsolete tool outputs from conversation context

type=plugin source=npm:@gblab/opencode-dcp created=2026-08-06T10:23:38.577Z firstSeen=2026-11-03T14:29:15.298Z published=2026-08-26T20:30:41.664Z maintainers=gerardbalaoro repoId=1323028417 stars=0 npm30d=?

{
    "$schema": "https://json.schemastore.org/package.json",
    "name": "@gblab/opencode-dcp",
    "version": "0.2.0",
    "type": "module",
    "packageManager": "bun@1.3.14",
    "description": "OpenCode plugin that optimizes token usage by pruning obsolete tool outputs from conversation context",
    "main": "./dist/index.js",
    "types": "./dist/index.d.ts",
    "exports": {
        ".": {
            "types": "./dist/index.d.ts",
            "import": "./dist/index.js"
        },
        "./server": {
            "types": "./dist/index.d.ts",
            "import": "./dist/index.js"
        },
        "./tui": {
            "types": "./dist/tui.d.ts",
            "import": "./dist/tui.js"
        }
    },
    "scripts": {
        "clean": "rm -rf dist",
        "schema:generate": "bun scripts/generate-schema.ts",
        "schema:check": "bun scripts/generate-schema.ts --check",
        "build": "bun run schema:generate && tsdown && tsc --emitDeclarationOnly",
        "prepare": "lefthook install",
        "prepublishOnly": "bun run build",
        "dev": "opencode plugin dev",
        "typecheck": "tsc --noEmit",
        "test": "node --import tsx --test tests/*.test.ts",
        "lint": "oxlint",
        "format": "oxfmt",
        "format:check": "oxfmt --check",
        "dcp": "bun scripts/print.ts"
    },
    "keywords": [
        "opencode",
        "opencode-plugin",
        "plugin",
        "context",
        "pruning",
        "optimization",
        "tokens"
    ],
    "repository": {
        "type": "git",
        "url": "git+https://github.com/gerardbalaoro/opencode-dcp.git"
    },
    "bugs": {
        "url": "https://github.com/gerardbalaoro/opencode-dcp/issues"
    },
    "homepage": "https://github.com/gerardbalaoro/opencode-dcp#readme",
    "author": "tarquinen",
    "license": "AGPL-3.0-or-later",
    "peerDependencies": {
        "@opencode-ai/plugin": ">=1.17.0 <1.19.0"
    },
    "dependencies": {
        "@anthropic-ai/tokenizer": "^0.0.4",
        "@gblab/opencode-dcp": ".",
        "@opencode-ai/sdk": "^1.4.3",
        "@opentui/core": "0.5.1",
        "@opentui/solid": "0.5.1",
        "jsonc-parser": "^3.3.1",
        "solid-js": "1.9.12",
        "zod": "4.4.3"
    },
    "devDependencies": {
        "@opencode-ai/plugin": "1.18.13",
        "@types/node": "^24.0.0",
        "lefthook": "^2.1.10",
        "oxfmt": "0.62.0",
        "oxlint": "1.77.0",
        "tsdown": "0.22.14",
        "tsx": "^4.21.0",
        "typescript": "^6.0.2"
    },
    "overrides": {
        "@babel/core": "7.29.7",
        "esbuild": "0.28.1"
    },
    "files": [
        "dist/",
        "dcp.schema.json",
        "README.md",
        "LICENSE"
    ]
}
